answer: Reputation Crystal Freeze. Each agent identity accrues a reputation crystal that only unlocks after N consecutive verified actions; the crystal is bound to the operator's service endpoint, not the wallet. If a cluster of new identities shares a fingerprint (endpoint, timing plume, funding source), the operator's entire endpoint is frozen and its accrued crystals forfeit, blocking all identities it runs. An attacker must therefore build and age a fresh endpoint oasis per sybil batch, paying full hosting, latency, and time-to-unlock costs per batch instead of per wallet.
